en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a city square with a richly decorated fountain in the foreground and a large domed building in the background. The fountain has ornate tile‑like decoration and lion‑head spouts, surrounded by a circular flower bed. The domed building behind it stands on a raised terrace with steps and resembles an old mosque or church in a historic European town. Surrounding multi‑story buildings line the street. On the image border, printed captions read "Pécs" at the bottom left and "Zsolnai kút" at the bottom right. The reverse side contains Hungarian handwriting, an address to Budapest, a Hungarian postage stamp, and a postmark.
